items.summary: Extend the theme system so users can select four themes: White, Black, Orange, and Yellow, with the selection persisted in localStorage and applied on page load.

Update the global CSS theme variables in frontend/src/index.css to define appropriate CSS custom property sets for the White, Black, Orange, and Yellow themes so that Tailwind tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, border-border, bg-primary, bg-accent, ring, etc.) visually change with the selected theme.
Update the bottom ThemeToggleBar to let the user switch among the four themes (White, Black, Orange, Yellow) and ensure aria-label text accurately reflects the action and the available themes.

Ensure the circular indicator in ThemeToggleBar continues to reflect the currently active theme colors by relying on existing semantic tokens (e.g., bg-primary and bg-accent) so it updates automatically for White/Black/Orange/Yellow themes as well.
